# Codebase Overview

*Generated by /shipwithai-starter on 2026-07-01. Update when structure changes.*

## Entry points

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `controller/admin/**` | JWT-secured Admin API — Org/Project/Environment/FeatureFlag CRUD |
| `controller/auth/**` | Login / JWT issuance |
| `controller/sdk/**` (`EvaluationController`) | API-key-secured SDK flag evaluation |

## Key directories

| Directory | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `config/` | Spring config, including `SecurityConfig` (defines both filter chains) |
| `controller/` | HTTP handlers, split by `admin/`, `auth/`, `sdk/` |
| `domain/entity/` | JPA entities (Organization, Project, Environment, FeatureFlag, FlagEnvironmentState, etc.) |
| `domain/enums/` | Domain enums (e.g. roles) |
| `dto/request/`, `dto/response/` | Request/response payloads |
| `exception/` | Exception handling |
| `repository/` | Spring Data JPA repositories |
| `security/` | `ApiKeyAuthenticationFilter`, `JwtAuthenticationFilter`, principals |
| `service/`, `service/impl/` | Business logic, including `PermissionService` |
| `util/` | `ApiKeyGenerator` and other utilities |
| `src/main/resources/db/changelog/migrations/` | Liquibase changesets (001–007), append-only |

## Data flow

**Admin API:** `Request` → `JwtAuthenticationFilter` (sets `UserPrincipal`) → `controller/admin/**` → `service/impl/**` (calls `PermissionService` for authz) → `repository/**` → `Response`

**SDK evaluation:** `Request` (`X-Environment-Key` header) → `ApiKeyAuthenticationFilter` (resolves `Environment`, sets `ApiKeyAuthenticationToken`) → `EvaluationController` → `EvaluationService.getAllFlags(env)` → loads `FlagEnvironmentState` rows, filters archived → `Response`

## What NOT to edit manually

- `src/main/resources/db/changelog/migrations/001–007` — already-run Liquibase changesets are immutable; add a new changeset instead of editing an existing one.

## Sensitive areas

- `security/` and `SecurityConfig` — two-filter-chain design, order matters (SDK chain order=1, Admin chain order=2)
- `util/ApiKeyGenerator` and the API-key rotation endpoint
- `db/changelog/migrations/` — schema changes
